package cache

import (
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"fmt"
	"time"

	"github.com/redis/go-redis/v9"

	"github.com/example/app/internal/model"
	"github.com/example/app/internal/repository"
)

const UserCacheTTL = 300 * time.Second

// userCacheRepo decorates UserRepository, caching GetByID in Redis.
// Cache errors degrade to the underlying repository; they are never
// propagated to the caller.
type userCacheRepo struct {
	repo repository.UserRepository
	rdb  *redis.Client
}

// NewUserRepoWithCache wraps a repository with a Redis cache decorator.
func NewUserRepoWithCache(repo repository.UserRepository, rdb *redis.Client) repository.UserRepository {
	return &userCacheRepo{repo: repo, rdb: rdb}
}

func (c *userCacheRepo) Create(ctx context.Context, m *model.User) error {
	return c.repo.Create(ctx, m)
}

func (c *userCacheRepo) GetByID(ctx context.Context, id int64) (*model.User, error) {
	key := fmt.Sprintf("users:%v", id)
	data, err := c.rdb.Get(ctx, key).Bytes()
	if err == nil {
		var m model.User
		if json.Unmarshal(data, &m) == nil {
			return &m, nil
		}
	}
	m, dbErr := c.repo.GetByID(ctx, id)
	if dbErr != nil {
		return nil, dbErr
	}
	if encoded, err := json.Marshal(m); err == nil {
		_ = c.rdb.Set(ctx, key, encoded, UserCacheTTL).Err()
	}
	return m, nil
}

func (c *userCacheRepo) List(ctx context.Context, page int, pageSize int) ([]*model.User, int64, error) {
	return c.repo.List(ctx, page, pageSize)
}

func (c *userCacheRepo) Update(ctx context.Context, m *model.User) error {
	err := c.repo.Update(ctx, m)
	if err == nil {
		key := fmt.Sprintf("users:%v", m.Id)
		_ = c.rdb.Del(ctx, key).Err()
	}
	return err
}

func (c *userCacheRepo) Delete(ctx context.Context, id int64) error {
	err := c.repo.Delete(ctx, id)
	if err == nil {
		key := fmt.Sprintf("users:%v", id)
		_ = c.rdb.Del(ctx, key).Err()
	}
	return err
}
